limitations: Only physical production inputs are used; no arbitrary carry is declared clean.
The prefix and public-carry seam have open HMR debts and are value-only panels.
The full paired key checks arbitrary diagonal and cubic probes plus all restoration.
This is not a full decoder, official price, or new population experiment.

exact_source_expectation.scope: Source expectation from actual helper calls and uniform fresh masks; not official sampling.

deferred_component_gates.scope: Existing component receipts only; no v3 build, joined check, salt or new failure bound is inferred.

preserved_v2_sources.scope: No circuit is loaded or rerun; this identity gate is not a v3 native result.

prior_integration_sources.scope: Preserves prior source evidence; no v2 native result is inferred.

accepted_base_gate.scope: File identity only; new candidate correctness and failure transfer are separate gates
